After White's weak d3 pawn push, Black's queen captures with check (Qxd3+). This forces the White king to e1—the only legal move. The queen now forks the king and rook, and Black finishes with Rxc1#, a back-rank mate. The key lesson: when your opponent leaves a piece undefended and their king lacks escape squares, look for forcing checks that win material or deliver mate. Always calculate checks first!
